latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of local-whisper-hardened.
- Provides local speech-to-text transcription using OpenAI Whisper, fully offline after model download.
- Supports multiple Whisper model sizes for speed/accuracy balance.
- Output options include timestamps and JSON.
- Enforces key security guardrails: strict package installation, no piping output to shells, and no network transmission of transcripts.
